name: Engineering: Electrical and Computer Engineering Concentration
description: The electrical and computer engineering concentration option within the engineering program focuses on providing depth in the areas of digital and analog systems analysis and design, as well as computing technology. Students completing this option may pursue careers in a variety of industries that require electronic hardware and computer software expertise.
